references.text: Refers to the Canaanite king of Arad who lived in the Negev and heard about the coming of the Israelites.
Mentions the king of Arad among the kings whom Joshua and the Israelites defeated.
Describes the Negev region and battles against the Canaanites, including the destruction of Arad (Hormah).
An earlier event where the Amalekites and Canaanites defeated the Israelites at Hormah, in the same geographical area.
The continuation of the story where Israel defeats the Canaanites and names the place Hormah.
Abraham traveled through the Negev, the same area where the Canaanite king of Arad lived.
Abraham settled in the Negev region, the same area mentioned in this text.
